description: Sign out of Brightspace on this computer: cancel any sign-in still waiting for MFA approval here, then delete the saved Brightspace session, so every Brightspace app here must sign in again from scratch on its next question. Keeps the saved password, settings, and authenticator key. Does not sign out of Microsoft or Brightspace on other devices. Cancelling a waiting sign-in doesn't get a new prompt sooner: Microsoft sends no other prompt to the account until the one already sent expires, up to 5 minutes after it was sent. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to sign out or log out of Brightspace (a shared computer, handing the machine on). Never call it on your own to fix an error, to get a new prompt, or as part of answering another question.
name: sign_out
title: Sign Out of Brightspace
